newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon Invest increases capital to $40 mln.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon Invest increases capital to $40 mln.

text.p: Beirut finance house Lebanon Invest S.A.L. said on Wednesday it increased its capital by $14 million to $40 million through a private share placement.
"Lebanon Invest Group finalised with complete success the capital increase to $40 million from $26 million, fully paid," LI said in a statement.

"The operation was completed by the joining of more than 40 new shareholders to the Group which now includes more than 110 shareholders, both individuals and institutions from several European countries and Arab states from the Middle East and the Gulf," LI added in its statement.
The existing shareholders include Saudi Prince Walid Bin Talal. Lebanon Invest said in January that the billionaire prince has taken a "small stake" in the finance house in December.
The capital increase was decided by a shareholders meeting in December.
Lebanon Invest Group was founded in 1995 and initially grouped more than 65 shareholders, including companies and Arab businessmen.
